name: Albra · The Vale of the Hollow
note: Hand-written. Coordinates are on a w x h parchment (1600 x 1000), bigger than the screen: the map scrolls. A location's map/spawn is where travelling there puts you; 'locked' ones show on the map but can't be reached yet; 'known' ones are on the map from the start, the rest appear once visited (or once a neighbour is visited, if 'seen' lists it). Wrenford, the new University town where a new game starts, lies far to the west on the river Wren. The river is the Hollow: it rises in the western uplands, runs east past Wrenford (where the Wren joins it) and Hollowmere (just outside Corvanthe's walls), into the city through Cindergate, through the Wound, out through the Drowned Quarter and east to the Wolf Sea. The Moriquende leads to Elfhome, where the forest year (js/forest.js) is played; Mother Agathe puts it on the map once you've graduated. Travel takes time (WORLD_SPEED in js/explore.js, 25 units an hour): a journey stops at the first wayside inn on its way (kind 'inn', no map: you sleep there and travel on); Wrenford to Eynham or Eynham to Hollowmere is about 9 hours, a day's ride.

locations.name: Wrenford
locations.blurb: The new University town on the river Wren, founded by the scholars of Corvanthe who were away on the day. Nothing here is ruined. Everything here is careful.

locations.name: Hollowmere
locations.blurb: The last town before Corvanthe, and a boom town since the gleaners came: the west bank is crowded with carters, factors and crews going in, and the Ore Road to Gilden runs through it. Across the Hollow the east bank is dead, and nobody sleeps there.

locations.name: The Corvanthe Road
locations.blurb: The old cobbled road from Hollowmere to the walls of Corvanthe. Gleaners camp along it.

locations.name: Corvanthe
locations.blurb: The great university city, ruined in the Unweaving. Its citizens walk its streets still, as Echoes. The gleaners have cut a way in through the Wardgate, into Cindergate.

locations.name: The Moriquende
locations.blurb: The elf-wood at the end of the West Road, older than the University and older than Corvanthe. Elfhome is in its heart, and Sylvara is its Warden.

locations.name: Eynham
locations.blurb: A bridge town on the Hollow, a day's ride from Wrenford: a toll bridge, a market cross and the Swan, whose beds are clean and whose landlord asks no questions.

locations.name: The Last Lantern
locations.blurb: The last inn on the West Road before the elf-wood, a day out of Wrenford. A lantern burns in its window all night, for travellers and, the landlady says, for whatever else is out there.

features.note: Drawn by js/world_ink.js (WorldInk), cached under the roads and places: mountain ranges along a spine (`ranges`), zones of symbols (`wood` massed crowns, `hill`, `grass` moor tufts, `marsh`, `tree` lone trees), side rivers, the Wolf Sea with ripple lines off its coast, `ruins`, the rune frame, the `title` cartouche, the `compass` rose and the `scale` in leagues (a league is an hour's walk, WORLD_SPEED units). `labels` are [text,x,y,rot] (a region) or {text,x,y,rot,style,size,path}: styles region / danger (red capitals) / sea / river / note / rednote, `path` to letter along a line. `moon` holds moon-letters, Arcana glyphs shown only by night.
